surface_verification.justification: CI-only change with no runtime surface. The diff is two GitHub Actions workflow files, the vendored guard suite under scripts/ci/tests/, a docstring correction in scripts/ci/pr_review.py, and agent docs. It touches no API route, no store mutation, no SSE/WS handler, no message contract and no client code, so the Backend-affects-Frontend rule does not fire and there is nothing a browser could observe. The behaviour that DID change is the workflow shell itself, and it is executed rather than asserted: scripts/ci/tests/test_pr_review_stage2_{decide,verdict}.py lift each run: body out of pr-review-run.yml and run it in bash against a stubbed gh (44 executed cases covering pagination, tier/waiver ordering, the 64KiB and 3000-entry fail-open paths, every verdict branch, and the A-B-A force-push race). Full stack green regardless: 191 vendored + 3101 server + 3115 client.
